subject: SIG completion: evidence delivery plan & security deck transfer
messages:
From: Ben Turner <security@medivex.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@medivex.com
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG intake: last items for SOC 2, pen test and security deck

Hi Olga / Rishi,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. We're trying to close our internal SIG review by next Friday and have a quick gap list. Could you confirm which of the following artifacts you can provide and when?

- SOC 2 Type II report (2026) — redacted version acceptable
- Pen test executive summary that can be shared with partners (sanitized)
- ISO statements/certificates (ISO 27001 or equivalent)
- Security overview/deck for our architecture review (pptx ok)

If you can share a timeline (and a single zip or Drive link) that'd be ideal. Also, do you allow a short (15–20 min) follow-up call for clarifying any SIG answers once we ingest the files?

We're the final approver for this integration so getting those artifacts will unblock procurement.

Thanks,
Ben Turner
Head of Security Programs
MediVex Health
security@medivex.com

Attachment: SIG_template_v3.xlsx (requested checklist)

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Ben Turner <security@medivex.com>, procurement@medivex.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG intake: last items for SOC 2, pen test and security deck

Hi Ben — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Summary / plan below:

1) SOC 2 Type II (2026) — we can provide a redacted PDF by end of day Monday (2027-01-18).
2) Pen test executive summary — we have a sanitized 2-page summary ready; will include with SOC 2 packet on Monday.
3) ISO statement (ISO 27001 declaration of applicability) — we can provide the attestation letter; delivery target Wednesday (2027-01-20) to allow legal sign-off.
4) Security deck — I'll attach the latest Redwood_Security_Deck_v3.pptx with notes; we'll provide both editable pptx and a PDF.

Delivery method: I will upload a single zip to a shared Drive folder (link below) and send a DocuSign link for a minimal NDA/redaction confirmation if you need it to accompany the SOC2 file.

Proposed call: Tue 2027-01-19 10:00am PT — 20 minutes for quick clarifications. Does that work for your team?

Drive link (staging): https://drive.redwood.example.com/sig/RDW-5821-evidence

I'll mark action items for Rishi to confirm redaction policy and for Vanessa to coordinate procurement cadence.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments planned: SOC2_report_2026_redacted.pdf (stub), pen_test_summary_2026_sanitized.pdf (stub), ISO27001_statement_2026.pdf (stub), Redwood_Security_Deck_v3.pptx (stub)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Ben Turner <security@medivex.com>, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG intake: last items for SOC 2, pen test and security deck

Ben / Olga — quick clarifications from the security team: 

- SOC2: We will redact customer-identifying information (customer lists, specific IPs and contact emails) from the report. Redacted PDF will include auditor name, scope, and opinion.
- Pen test: The exec summary excludes proof-of-concept exploit details; it contains findings, severity, and mitigation status. If MediVex needs a deeper technical appendix we can discuss a narrowly-scoped NDA.
- ISO: We don't currently hold a full external ISO 27001 certificate; instead we provide an internal statement of applicability and our control mapping. We label this as "ISO statements" in the SIG answers. If an external certificate is mandatory for your compliance baseline, flag that now so we can escalate procurement and legal.

Operational notes: I'll upload the sanitized files to the Drive folder by EOD Monday (2027-01-18) and will add a short notes doc describing redactions and validation points.

Call: Tue 2027-01-19 10:00am PT works for me.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai

Thanks — that timeline works. A few quick notes: 

- Redacted SOC2 + pen-test summary is acceptable for our SIG.
- ISO: the procurement team prefers an externally-issued certificate but can accept the statement as interim evidence; we'll flag in our risk memo and confirm later.
- Please add a short README in the Drive zip that lists each file and the specific redactions performed (helps our auditors).
- DocuSign: yes, please send the redaction acknowledgement as a quick DocuSign (procurement needs this for the internal file).

Call confirmed: Tue 2027-01-19 10:00am PT — we'll join with two folks from security and one from procurement.

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Once we receive the zip and NDA ack we'll mark RDW-5821 as "Compliance evidence collected" in our repo.

Best,
